decision: Test ordinary indirect-reference semantics at nested consumer boundaries rather than infer them from generic dictionary lookup.
basis: §7.3.10 makes direct/indirect values equivalent except where documented. The relevant ExtGState entries have no direct-only restriction for /D, /BM, or /ca. Table 57 explicitly requires /Font's font item to be an indirect reference, so that exception is excluded from the equivalence claim.
ADR_review: ADR 2820 section 3 selects the first recognized blend mode in a deprecated array and addresses transparency detection, not indirect representation. Its rationale remains valid; the draft checks that indirection does not change the selected mode.
ADR 1157/1342 concerns overprint and transparency construction, not reference resolution; no premise there is changed by this shard.
policy: Use PDF1.7 to avoid the deprecatedPDF2.0 array form in this witness. Deprecation does not itself mean a forbidden or invalid representation. Pixeloracles derive from literal blendformula.
